action_summary: Rounds 23-25 measured compress-admit-replay by calling compression_gain_v1 directly and supplying the probe domain from the test; round 25 named the gap itself ('organs enter the library only through a caller that can supply real domain probes'). This round drove the LIVE path (MetaCircularOrganGraph.register_organ -> CompoundingConceptLibrary -> rewrite_source_with_concepts) with no caller probes and measured that it worked zero times: three registered world-model organs of one family left the library EMPTY, the never-seen member was refused, and three different organs produced ONE concept id (the bridge built 'c_' + organ_id.replace('organ_skill_','')[:18], which leaves 'c_organ_skill_' for every SKILL organ). Five defects were found and each is sufficient to stop the loop: (1) no probe domain at the live entry, so the numeric default grid ran against a string-keyed table and the correct vacuity gate refused everything; (2) both gates read ANY exception as a behaviour change, so 'identical except where the table has no row' -- what every keyed lookup is -- was unmeasurable; (3) the colliding identifier; (4) admission fired only for organ.stratum == SKILL while the second family is emitted by synthesize_world_model_organ, a WORLD_MODEL organ, so the live writer for that family did not exist; (5) the wake entry returned the replay engine's REPORT DICT on the abstraction branch and source text elsewhere, and returning the source alone produced a program whose concept id was undefined. Built: derive_probe_domain (domain derived from corpus literals -- a prior, not an oracle), admit_corpus_abstraction (one live admission call that reports which domain was used), partial-function equivalence at both gates, concept_id_for_source, _ADMISSIBLE_STRATA=(SKILL, WORLD_MODEL), and one executable return type. NO gate was widened: the vacuity gate still refuses a non-discriminating grid (pinned), one site is still a stored program and not a rule (pinned), and the periodic family's measured gain 67 is unchanged (pinned).
explicit_user_authorization: Owner directive on 2026-11-12: 'And always after you make any of your work, push and merge your work always.' $0 spend, no protected or SHA-pinned paths touched, no sentience claim, no governance change.

routes_ranked: 1. Derive the domain from the corpus literals; keep both gates exactly as strict -- chosen: no new knowledge, no new authority, one rule
2. Widen the default numeric grid -- rejected: cannot see a string key by construction
3. Let the bridge accept a domain from the graph layer -- rejected: the graph has no domain knowledge and would only move the human
4. Relax the vacuity gate so admission can fire -- rejected: that is the gate a forged abstraction sails through
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Widening a float grid or relaxing the vacuity gate would buy admission at the cost of the only check that distinguishes a verified abstraction from a confident one.

obs_verification.synthetic_verification_necessity: The oracle is the world's answers through real execution: the never-seen organ and its replay run on held-out action ids including unknowns, the empty string and a case variant; the vacuity gate is exercised by a numeric grid that must refuse; the first family's measured gain 67 is re-run as regression; the curve itself is asserted (1,0), (2,0), (3,1). The prediction was written before the confirmatory run and the tests can fail.
